about.title: The Person Behind Phós
about.body: For Nikolas Pateras, optics goes beyond a profession. As the founder and lead optometrist at Phós, he brings his strong background in Optometry and years of practical experience. Phós Optics was created as a modern optical space where science meets design. Where the approach for eye care is done with precision, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of individual needs.
about.quote: “Through Phós (greek: φώς, meaning: light) the goal is simple: see better, feel better, and express effortlessly.”

philosophy.title: Light: phosgene. Φώς
philosophy.subtitle: [From Greek phos, light;]
philosophy.body: Inspired by nature, focused on clarity. We keep the dash above the letter O to preserve its authentic Greek pronunciation. Vision is medical. Style is personal. At Phos Optics we excel at both.
